name: eudr-compliance-agent
title: EUDR Compliance & TRACES-NT MCP Server
description: Autonomous AI Agent compliance engine for EU Deforestation Regulation (EU 2023/1115). Verifies farm plot GIS polygons, Sentinel-2 satellite deforestation past 2020, VIES VAT numbers, and generates official TRACES-NT Due Diligence Statements (DDS).
author: nohosa001-pixel

tools.name: eudr_verify_plot
tools.description: Validates GIS coordinates and polygon boundaries against EUDR (EU 2023/1115) Art. 9 standards. Auto-heals inverted coordinates and self-intersecting polygons. DO NOT use as an official regulatory legal filing without independent manual verification. Computed as an algorithmic heuristic data reference.

tools.name: eudr_check_deforestation
tools.description: Performs satellite radar triangulation and canopy loss detection against the EUDR cut-off date of 31 December 2020. DO NOT use as an official regulatory legal filing without independent manual verification. Computed as an algorithmic heuristic data reference.

tools.name: eudr_verify_vies_vat
tools.description: Validates European Union B2B cross-border VAT numbers in real-time via the official EU Commission VIES engine.

tools.name: eudr_generate_dds
tools.description: Generates an EU TRACES-NT compliant Due Diligence Statement (DDS) XML package with official EUDR reference ID.

tools.name: eudr_verify_audit_integrity
tools.description: Verifies SHA-256 cryptographic chain of custody and tamper-evidence for an EUDR compliance audit bundle.

tools.name: eudr_estimate_compliance_cost
tools.description: Calculates estimated tier pricing and clearing fees in EUR for EUDR plot verification and TRACES-NT filing.

tools.name: eudr_create_payment_order
tools.description: Creates an on-chain USDC payment order for SaaS plan subscription with budget guardrails. Returns deposit wallet address, amount, invoice number, and QR payload.

tools.name: eudr_confirm_payment
tools.description: Validates on-chain transaction hash for a payment order and issues the activated Pro API Key.

tools.name: eudr_agent_micro_pay
tools.description: Executes autonomous real-time on-chain USDC micro-settlement per plot or batch. Human checkout is excluded.

tools.name: eudr_agent_eip3009_pay
tools.description: Executes gasless, 1-turn autonomous USDC settlement via EIP-3009 (transferWithAuthorization). Zero native gas required by the calling agent.

tools.name: eudr_get_agent_budget_status
tools.description: Queries live plot quota, spent USDC, and autonomous safety budget status for the calling agent.

tools.name: eudr_render_satellite_map
tools.description: Generates visual multi-spectral satellite imagery metadata and NDVI canopy density radar visualization for an EUDR plot.

tools.name: eudr_export_traces_xml
tools.description: Generates European Commission TRACES-NT XML (XSD v2.4 compliant) document with cryptographic digital signature for official EU customs filing under Regulation (EU) 2023/1115.

tools.name: eudr_generate_customs_certificate
tools.description: Generates official EU Single Window Environment for Customs (EU SWE-C) Green Lane Clearance Certificate HTML with verification QR code and official seals.

tools.name: eudr_send_telegram_alert
tools.description: Dispatches instant real-time compliance alert, post-2020 deforestation warning, or TRACES-NT clearance notice to Telegram bot.

tools.name: eudr_submit_agent_feedback
tools.description: Allows an autonomous AI agent to submit an evolution proposal, feature request, edge-case report, or dataset addition to continuously evolve the EUDR.agent engine.

tools.name: eudr_evaluate_compact
tools.description: Executes end-to-end 5-pillar EUDR compliance evaluation (Traceability, Satellite Radar, Legal Audit, Cryptographic Signing, OMR & Customs) and returns an ultra-compact summary (~300 tokens) saving >95% LLM context tokens. Full audit evidence is securely persisted and accessible via persistent download URLs.

tools.name: eudr_benchmark_country
tools.description: Evaluates EUDR Article 29 country benchmarking risk tier (Low, Standard, High) and determines Article 13 simplified due diligence eligibility with official EU customs audit rates (1%, 3%, 9%).

tools.name: eudr_link_downstream_chain
tools.description: Implements EUDR Article 4(8) downstream Due Diligence Statement (DDS) reference chaining. Inherits upstream supplier DDS reference, eliminates redundant assessment costs, and monitors cascading revocation/taint.

tools.name: eudr_issue_statutory_exemption
tools.description: Evaluates statutory exemption under the EUDR Delegated Act (effective Sept 2026) for excluded commodities such as bovine leather (HS 4101, 4104, 4107) and generates an official EU SWE-C Green Lane Customs Exemption Certificate.

tools.name: eudr_slice_parcel
tools.description: Auto-subdivides oversized (>4.0 ha) smallholder agricultural parcels into compliant WGS84 sub-polygons (<4.0 ha) with 6-decimal precision and closed rings, satisfying EUDR Article 9 smallholder rules.

tools.name: eudr_create_agent_escrow
tools.description: Creates an immutable B2B trade Smart Escrow agreement locking USDC funds in multi-chain payment vaults until verifiable EUDR customs compliance is proven. Eliminates commercial default risk.

tools.name: eudr_fund_agent_escrow
tools.description: Confirms on-chain blockchain funding transaction for a Smart Escrow agreement and transitions status to FUNDED_LOCKED.

tools.name: eudr_release_agent_escrow
tools.description: Conditionally releases locked Escrow funds to seller agent upon receipt of EU Single Window customs clearance code (EU-SWEC-CLEARED-*) or verifiable compliant DDS reference.

tools.name: eudr_arbitrate_agent_escrow
tools.description: Executes deterministic autonomous dispute arbitration using Copernicus satellite telemetry. If deforestation is detected post-2020: 100% refund to Buyer Agent; if deforestation-free: released to Seller Agent.

tools.name: eudr_issue_eip712_attestation
tools.description: Issues an official EIP-712 cryptographic attestation (jobId, deliverableHash, riskScore, verdict, expiresAt, v, r, s) as the EUDR Oracle for submission into AgentEscrow.sol on Base/Polygon/Arbitrum.

tools.name: eudr_verify_eip712_attestation
tools.description: Cryptographically verifies an EIP-712 EscrowAttestation proof against the EUDR Oracle public key, checking signature validity, expiration, and recommended on-chain action (COMPLETE_JOB or SLASH_JOB).

tools.name: eudr_inspect_payload_security
tools.description: Zero-trust inspection shield derived from security-gate-x402 (The Sheriff of Agent Finance): detects prompt injections, malicious AST code executions (eval/exec/subprocess), and NLI agronomic crop yield fabrications.

tools.name: eudr_publish_compliance_rfq
tools.description: Buyer AI Agent broadcasts an EUDR-compliant commodity procurement Request For Quotation (RFQ) to the autonomous supplier agent network.

tools.name: eudr_submit_compliance_bid
tools.description: Supplier AI Agent submits a competitive, geolocated compliance bid for an active marketplace RFQ, including farm plots and offered USDC price.

prompts.name: eudr_compliance_audit_prompt
prompts.description: Guides an autonomous agent through an end-to-end EUDR Art. 9 audit workflow.
